name: tls
description: A TLS 1.3 client (RFC 8446) without I/O: TLS_AES_128_GCM_SHA256 with an X25519 key share, ECDSA and RSA-PSS server signatures, SNI, ALPN, HelloRetryRequest, KeyUpdate and close_notify; bytes in any split, application records opened in place in the receive buffer and sealed in place in the pending one.

options.name: roots
options.question: Where does TLS take the roots it trusts from?

choices.description: the operating system verifies the chain (trust, Verify::Caller): its roots, updated with it, enterprise roots included
the operating system verifies (trust, Verify::Caller), with Mozilla's roots built in where it has none, as Linux in an empty container (roots)
x509 verifies against Mozilla's roots built in (roots, Verify::Store): the same everywhere; rr add --overwrite roots or scripts/roots-gen.py refreshes it
x509 verifies against a store the program fills itself (Verify::Store)
